svg.title: AI-Pong two-point crossover
svg.desc: The exact half-open neuron interval used to make reciprocal children, with neuron bias and connection weight provenance shown from the shared GA masks.
svg.text: Neuron selection and parameter ownership use the same interval masks as the genetic algorithm.
Selected neurons inherit incoming weights and biases; connections from selected neurons in the previous layer inherit from that same parent.
The strip shows the exact concatenated layer-output index order. Mutation is applied to offspring after crossover.
